headline: Frequent Rework of hugofs/fs.go
diagnosis: The file hugofs/fs.go is undergoing repeated changes primarily related to symlink handling and performance issues. The commit messages indicate a pattern of fixes and reverts, especially concerning symlink reads and performance regressions, suggesting instability in these areas.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the symlink handling logic in hugofs/fs.go to identify potential flaws or edge cases that may lead to regressions.
Implement comprehensive unit tests specifically targeting symlink functionalities to ensure reliability and prevent future regressions.

Analyze the performance issues mentioned in the commit messages, particularly the 'Fix /static performance regression' and 'Fix PostProcess regression', to identify root causes and optimize the relevant code paths.
Establish a code review process that emphasizes the importance of stability in critical areas like file handling to reduce the likelihood of future reworks.
owner_hint: Ownership should be shared among the core maintainers of the hugofs package.
